name: Super 3 Team Custom Synergy System

tracks.label: Command Center
tracks.objective: One shared account state with role-specific next decisions.

tracks.label: Customer Journey
tracks.objective: Preserve outcome, lifecycle, promises, decisions, and evidence across every handoff.

tracks.label: Coverage & Ownership
tracks.objective: Make CSM, TAM, Partner, Support, Services, Product, and Engineering ownership explicit.

tracks.label: Handoffs
tracks.objective: Transfer work without making the customer repeat context or guess who owns the next move.

tracks.label: Technical Work
tracks.objective: Coordinate configuration, APIs, integrations, troubleshooting, and evidence-ready escalation.

tracks.label: Threat & Takedown
tracks.objective: Track protected assets, monitoring, enforcement state, exceptions, and maintenance work.

tracks.label: Adoption & Value
tracks.objective: Tie product usage and technical enablement to customer-defined outcomes before expansion.

tracks.label: Risks & Escalations
tracks.objective: Surface customer-impact risk early with owner, evidence, next decision, and communication state.

tracks.label: Recurring Themes
tracks.objective: Turn repeated friction into documentation, enablement, packaging, automation, pricing, or product signal.

tracks.label: Meetings & Reviews
tracks.objective: Generate concise customer, partner, and internal reviews from current evidence.

tracks.label: Training Center
tracks.objective: Give CSMs, TAMs, and Partner teams role-specific operating guidance from the same system.

tracks.label: Evidence & Build
tracks.objective: Keep metric provenance, synthetic-data boundaries, build evidence, and internal efficiency proof visible.

role_problem_hypothesis: Customers must experience one coherent technical-success motion even though responsibility can cross a partner account team, baseline support, paid integration or managed services, the vendor TAM, CSM, Product, Engineering, and SOC. The system exists to preserve context, make ownership explicit, coordinate the three customer-facing teams, and turn recurring friction into scalable improvement.

values.label: Trust
values.design: Every claim has a source boundary; handoffs keep context; owners and commitments remain visible.

values.label: Think Big
values.design: Recurring themes become reusable documentation, automation, service design, packaging, or product improvement.

values.label: Mutual Respect
values.design: No customer ping-pong; disagreements preserve context, state the boundary, and name the next owner.

values.label: Customer Success
values.design: Customer-defined outcome and adoption state anchor technical and commercial decisions.

disclosure: Candidate-built synthetic operating prototype based on public role and product context. It is not an official company system, not a representation of private internal tooling, and contains no real customer records.

modeled.boundary: Directional estimate based on a completed local Quillgeist build; not provider billing telemetry and not a financial-savings claim.
